# Scholar ITS

> Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS) Indonesia is a leading research institution in Southeast Asia, recognized by THE World University Rankings and SINTA Awards, with strengths in engineering, AI, marine technology, and sustainable infrastructure.

Scholar ITS serves as the institutional research portal and repository for ITS, showcasing the university's academic output, faculty expertise, and research fingerprints across seven faculties and multiple research centers. The platform aggregates research profiles, institutional rankings, and collaboration networks for Indonesia's premier technology university based in Surabaya.

## Key Topics

- Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS)
- Machine Learning & AI
- Engineering Research
- Marine Technology
- Material Science
- Sustainable Infrastructure
- Times Higher Education (THE) Ranking
- SINTA Award
- Research Fingerprint
- Faculty Profiles
- Geopolymer Technology
- IoT & Control Systems
- Renewable Energy
- CFD & Propulsion Systems
- Digital Business & Entrepreneurship

## Institution Overview

- [ITS Homepage](https://scholar.its.ac.id): ITS Indonesia homepage: research institution with THE rankings and SINTA awards
- [ITS English Portal](https://scholar.its.ac.id/en/home): ITS English homepage showcasing university profile and academic rankings
- [ITS Main Research Portal](https://scholar.its.ac.id/en/home/index): ITS main portal with research output, rankings, and faculty directory
- [ITS Institutional Profile](https://scholar.its.ac.id/en/organisations/institut-teknologi-sepuluh-nopember): ITS institutional profile with research fingerprint in ML and engineering

## Academic Faculties

- [Faculty of Intelligent Electrical and Informatics Technology](https://scholar.its.ac.id/en/organisations/faculty-of-intelligent-electrical-and-informatics-technology): Faculty profile: Electrical, Informatics with AI and deep learning focus
- [Faculty of Marine Technology](https://scholar.its.ac.id/en/organisations/faculty-of-marine-technology): Faculty profile: Marine Technology with CFD and propulsion systems
- [Faculty of Civil, Planning, and Geo-Engineering](https://scholar.its.ac.id/en/organisations/faculty-of-civil-planning-and-geo-engineering): Faculty profile: Civil Planning, Geo-Engineering with geopolymer research
- [Faculty of Industrial Technology and System Engineering](https://scholar.its.ac.id/en/organisations/faculty-of-industrial-technology-and-system-engineering): Faculty profile: Industrial Technology with material science research
- [Faculty of Science and Data Analytics](https://scholar.its.ac.id/en/organisations/faculty-of-science-and-data-analytics): Faculty profile: Science and Data Analytics with material science research
- [Faculty of Medicine and Health](https://scholar.its.ac.id/en/organisations/faculty-of-medicine-and-health): Faculty profile: Medicine and Health aligned with UN SDGs
- [Faculty of Creative Design and Digital Business](https://scholar.its.ac.id/en/organisations/faculty-of-creative-design-and-digital-business): Faculty profile: Creative Design, Digital Business, SME entrepreneurship
- [School of Interdisciplinary Management and Technology](https://scholar.its.ac.id/en/organisations/school-of-interdisciplinary-management-and-technology): School profile: Interdisciplinary Management with renewable energy focus
- [Faculty of Vocation](https://scholar.its.ac.id/en/organisations/faculty-of-vocation): Faculty profile: Vocational Education with control systems and IoT
